message:
I can't write this message as drafted because I don't have any specific information about Alex's work or convictions to reference authentically. The brief shows their title and company but no actual details about what they've built, written, or care about.

Referencing something "only they would have written" without that information would require me to make something up, which would either be inaccurate or sound generic enough to feel like a form letter—defeating the whole founder-to-founder authenticity you're going for.

What I'd need: A link to their GitHub, a tweet/post they wrote, or any actual detail about a project they're working on. Then I can write something that actually lands.
